q: Are refractory bricks and castables covered by CBAM?
title: Are refractories covered by CBAM?
short: Refractory bricks and shapes under 6902 and 6903 are not covered. The catch is aluminous cement: calcium aluminate cement under 2523 30 is in Annex I, so a refractory maker exporting it as cement must supply embedded emissions.
audience: Refractory makers in Jharkhand, Odisha and Gujarat exporting to Europe

ul: Bricks, blocks and shapes: 6902 and 6903, not covered.
Monolithic castables and mortars: usually 3816, not covered.
Calcium aluminate cement sold as cement: 2523 30, covered, with indirect emissions counted.

p: The Commission proposed in December 2025 to extend CBAM to some downstream steel and aluminium products. As of October 2026 that is not law, so check Annex I again before each contract season.

senseible: Senseible reads your fuel and electricity invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so if a buyer asks for a product footprint you can answer from documents rather than estimates.
